notes: The fallback: any device that advertises the control service and matches no other profile. Everything is unconfirmed, which is the honest state of a model nobody has recorded yet -- and unconfirmed means there is no write path anywhere in the app.

stateRead.note: Every member of the family answers the HELLO at the start of a control session, so a session is attempted for any device that advertises the service.

battery.note: Displayed only if the device actually reports it. A model that does not will show as not having reported, not as 0%.

noiseControl.note: The modes and their masks are family-wide vocabulary, but nothing here shows this model accepting a write, so the modes are shown and cannot be pressed.

bassWave.note: The range would come from the device's own getter, so nothing is assumed about it -- and with no measured write path, nothing is written to it.

findMyEarbuds.note: Nothing rings a device this app has never recorded.
